info.title: Tempera Clearing API
info.description: Canonical preparation, authority binding, durable commit, and evidence reads for consequential Tempera actions. A prepared action is non-executable until a complete authority-bearing action is proposed and committed.

200.description: Required contract and authentication dependencies are ready
Action is structurally valid but was not persisted or dispatched

post.summary: Persist a non-executable canonical effect before authority is issued
post.description: Validates the prepared effect and source-locked adapter, binds it to one workspace/action/idempotency identity, and creates no provider outbox task.

200.description: Exact replay of an existing preparation

201.description: Prepared effect persisted without authority or dispatch

post.summary: Bind exact authority and Risk evidence to a prior prepared effect
Live-verify Risk evidence, then durably commit the exact previously prepared and authority-bound action

202.description: Commit decision and dispatch task durably recorded

scopes.clearing:actions:read: Read tenant-scoped Clearing actions and events
scopes.clearing:actions:commit: Commit an exact previously prepared action

riskEvidenceEnvelope.description: The original signed Risk Clearing evidence envelope. Clearing verifies it against Risk's live reservation before consuming final admission, then persists the exact envelope for durable outcome transitions. It is evidence, never execution authority.
